title: Cultural Intelligence
style: corporate electronic pop, 114 BPM, professional edge with warmth, intelligence as empathy theme, PLUGGED/MOSOKO philosophy, diverse global business, male vocal clear and direct, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
IQ gets you in the room
EQ keeps you there
CQ — cultural intelligence
Is the thing that's rare
Knowing how to read the table
Before you say a word
Knowing whose eye contact is respectful
And whose feels like a sword

[CHORUS]
Cultural intelligence
Not born — built daily
Cultural intelligence
PLUGGED delivers it — ably
One culture — one lesson — one morning
Cultural intelligence — no ignoring
The world runs on it
Now you do too

[VERSE 2]
Business in the Gulf — different rules
Business in Japan — different tools
Business in Nigeria — different pace
PLUGGED covers every case
Not a textbook — not a course
One practical lesson — daily force
Cultural intelligence — compound interest
Every morning — invest

[OUTRO]
Cultural intelligence. One lesson. Today. PLUGGED.
